question: 设函数 $f(t)$ 连续，令 $F(x,y) = \int_{0}^{y - x}(y - x - t)f(t)\mathrm{d}t$，则

options.A: $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y},\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}$
options.B: $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y},\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}$
options.C: $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial F}{\partial y},\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}$
options.D: $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial F}{\partial y},\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}$
